payload.rationale: Cannot repair the hard-gate id_integrity failure within Patch Generator constraints. The architecture options (O1–O4) list free-text risks that the validator expects to map to existing risk_register IDs (K1–K20), and several risks mentioned in options are absent from the risk_register. Fixing this requires either (a) editing the locked canonical section /plan_package/architecture/options to replace free-text risks with existing K* references (semantics/signoff impact), or (b) adding new risk_register entries with new K* IDs—both disallowed here (no locked section edits; no new ID-bearing entities). Requires reroute to schema/risk-governance owner to align representation rules and update canonical artifacts accordingly.
